$comment: Roadster facts for the landing page (spec 10.2). Every figure is as reported by news coverage of the 15 October 2026 reveal — claims by Tesla, not independently tested. Re-verify against Tesla's official Roadster page before launch and bump lastChecked.

sources.note: Store per-figure source links in sources array of each entry; re-verify at launch.

reveal.delayNote: Delayed from 1 October because of rain
reveal.summary: Second-generation Roadster revealed 15 October 2026 at SpaceX's McGregor test facility, after a one-day delay for rain. The car drove up a ramp, stuck to it upside down with its fan suction system, and flipped through the air using cold-gas thrusters. Roadster Arena recreates exactly that party trick, in browser multiplayer.

specs.label: 0 to 60 mph
specs.note: Timed at the event; under 1 s claimed. Under 0.59 s claimed for the Rocket version.

specs.label: Range
specs.note: Lower than the 620 miles promised in 2017.

specs.label: Cornering
specs.note: Claimed with the fan suction system.

trims.name: Performance
highlights: Full-width tail light, rear thruster array
trims.depositNote: $5,000 due at reservation (Electrek), described by Tesla as fully refundable; $45,000 within 10 days

trims.name: Thrust
highlights: Cornering beyond 2 g claimed with fan suction
trims.depositNote: Reported deposit per Tesla's reservation page

timeline.title: Second-gen Roadster unveiled
timeline.text: Prototype shown on a Roadstar chassis; Musk promises 0–60 in 1.9 s, 620 miles range and SpaceX-option cold-gas thrusters.

timeline.title: Repeated delays
timeline.text: Production slips year after year alongside Cybertruck; every previously announced date is missed.

timeline.title: 15 October: the reveal
timeline.text: Revealed at SpaceX McGregor. Drives up a ramp, sticks upside down, flips on thrusters. 0.81 s to 60 timed at the event.

timeline.title: Targeted production
timeline.text: Musk: quote "2028, actually". Roadster Arena treats this with appropriate optimism.

honesty.note: Tesla has missed every previously announced Roadster delivery date so far. All figures on this page are claims made by Tesla at the time of the reveal and have not been independently verified.

reservations.electrekNote: Electrek reports $5,000 due at reservation, described by Tesla as fully refundable, and $45,000 within 10 days.
